scope: Quantity and estimator text of every row of the reproduction map, the displays each row covers, and the artifacts of THIS repository that hold its record: 'run' lists files relative to a run directory (the generator verifies that the released runtime writes them, using the bundled example runs), 'records' names a measurement-record set of records/specs.json, 'campaign' names a campaign export module, 'module' names an analytical or accounting module, and 'absent' names a record the released code does not produce (a record contract of records/specs.json or records/specs.d whose manuscript_tables cover the row's displays, and whose experiments match the row's 'experiments' when both declare them, is then linked). Placeholders in braces are filled from configurations, registered constants and code.
